ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Quiero un café con leche y una tostada.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'd like a white coffee and a piece of toast.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Quero um café com leite e uma torrada.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: ¿Tienen alguna mesa libre para cuatro personas?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Do you have a free table for four people?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Vocês têm alguma mesa livre para quatro pessoas?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Ayer cenamos en un restaurante italiano muy bueno.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Yesterday we had dinner at a very good Italian restaurant.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Ontem jantamos em um restaurante italiano muito bom.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: De primero voy a tomar una ensalada mixta.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: For the first course I'm going to have a mixed salad.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: De entrada vou comer uma salada mista.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: ¿Qué nos recomienda de postre hoy?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: What do you recommend for dessert today?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O que você nos recomenda de sobremesa hoje?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: La cuenta, por favor, que tenemos prisa.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The bill, please, we're in a hurry.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A conta, por favor, que estamos com pressa.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Este pescado está muy rico, ¿verdad?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: This fish is really tasty, isn't it?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Este peixe está muito gostoso, né?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Marta ha pedido una paella para dos personas.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Marta has ordered a paella for two people.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A Marta pediu uma paella para duas pessoas.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: ¿Podemos sentarnos en la terraza, por favor?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Can we sit on the terrace, please?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Podemos sentar no terraço, por favor?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: No como carne, ¿tienen platos vegetarianos?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I don't eat meat; do you have vegetarian dishes?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Eu não como carne, vocês têm pratos vegetarianos?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Para beber, una botella de agua sin gas.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: To drink, a bottle of still water.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Para beber, uma garrafa de água sem gás.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: El camarero nos ha traído la comida muy rápido.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The waiter brought us the food very quickly.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O garçom nos trouxe a comida muito rápido.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: ¿Se puede pagar con tarjeta aquí?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Can you pay by card here?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Dá para pagar com cartão aqui?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Hoy el menú del día cuesta doce euros.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Today the set menu costs twelve euros.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Hoje o prato do dia custa doze euros.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Voy a pedir el filete con patatas fritas.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'm going to order the steak with chips.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Vou pedir o filé com batatas fritas.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: ¿Me pone un zumo de naranja natural?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Could I have a fresh orange juice?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Pode me ver um suco de laranja natural?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Perdone, esta sopa está un poco fría.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Excuse me, this soup is a bit cold.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Com licença, esta sopa está um pouco fria.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: El sábado pasado probamos un restaurante japonés nuevo.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Last Saturday we tried a new Japanese restaurant.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: No sábado passado experimentamos um restaurante japonês novo.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: ¿Cuánto tiempo hay que esperar para una mesa?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: How long do we have to wait for a table?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Quanto tempo tem que esperar por uma mesa?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Dos cañas y una ración de calamares, por favor.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Two small beers and a portion of squid, please.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Dois chopes e uma porção de lula, por favor.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Mis amigos van a pedir pizza para cenar.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: My friends are going to order pizza for dinner.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Meus amigos vão pedir pizza para o jantar.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: ¿El pan está incluido en el precio?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Is the bread included in the price?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O pão está incluído no preço?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Quería reservar una mesa para esta noche.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'd like to book a table for tonight.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Eu queria reservar uma mesa para hoje à noite.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: No me gusta mucho el café sin azúcar.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I don't really like coffee without sugar.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Não gosto muito de café sem açúcar.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: ¿Nos trae más servilletas, por favor?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Could you bring us more napkins, please?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Pode nos trazer mais guardanapos, por favor?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Hemos dejado una propina de cinco euros.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: We've left a five-euro tip.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Deixamos uma gorjeta de cinco euros.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: El restaurante cierra a las once de la noche.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The restaurant closes at eleven at night.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O restaurante fecha às onze da noite.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: ¿Qué lleva la ensalada de la casa?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: What's in the house salad?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O que vem na salada da casa?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Yo voy a tomar un té verde, gracias.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'm going to have a green tea, thanks.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Eu vou tomar um chá verde, obrigado.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Esta tarde quedamos en la cafetería de la esquina.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: This afternoon we're meeting at the café on the corner.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Hoje à tarde vamos nos encontrar na cafeteria da esquina.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Soy alérgico a los frutos secos, ¿lleva nueces?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: I'm allergic to nuts; does it have walnuts in it?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Sou alérgico a castanhas, tem nozes?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: La tarta de chocolate está buenísima.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The chocolate cake is delicious.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A torta de chocolate está deliciosa.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: ¿Me puede traer otro tenedor, por favor?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Could you bring me another fork, please?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Pode me trazer outro garfo, por favor?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Pedro siempre desayuna churros con chocolate los domingos.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Pedro always has churros with hot chocolate for breakfast on Sundays.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: O Pedro sempre toma café da manhã com churros e chocolate quente aos domingos.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Anoche pedimos la comida a domicilio.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Last night we had food delivered.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Ontem à noite pedimos comida para entregar em casa.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: ¿Para tomar aquí o para llevar?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: For here or to take away?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Para consumir aqui ou para viagem?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: La comida ha sido excelente, muchas gracias.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: The meal was excellent, thank you very much.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: A comida estava excelente, muito obrigado.

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Perdone, ¿está libre esta silla de aquí?
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: Excuse me, is this chair here free?
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Com licença, esta cadeira aqui está livre?

ordering at a café or restaurant.text: Un cortado y un cruasán, por favor.
ordering at a café or restaurant.en: A cortado and a croissant, please.
ordering at a café or restaurant.pt: Um café pingado e um croissant, por favor.

travel and directions.text: ¿Dónde está la estación de tren, por favor?
travel and directions.en: Where is the train station, please?
travel and directions.pt: Onde fica a estação de trem, por favor?

travel and directions.text: Siga todo recto y gire a la derecha.
travel and directions.en: Go straight on and turn right.
travel and directions.pt: Siga em frente e vire à direita.

travel and directions.text: El museo está al lado de la catedral.
travel and directions.en: The museum is next to the cathedral.
travel and directions.pt: O museu fica ao lado da catedral.

travel and directions.text: ¿Cuánto cuesta un billete de ida y vuelta?
travel and directions.en: How much is a return ticket?
travel and directions.pt: Quanto custa uma passagem de ida e volta?

travel and directions.text: El verano pasado fuimos a Portugal en coche.
travel and directions.en: Last summer we went to Portugal by car.
travel and directions.pt: No verão passado fomos para Portugal de carro.

travel and directions.text: Mañana voy a coger el autobús de las ocho.
travel and directions.en: Tomorrow I'm going to take the eight o'clock bus.
travel and directions.pt: Amanhã vou pegar o ônibus das oito.

travel and directions.text: ¿Está muy lejos el aeropuerto desde aquí?
travel and directions.en: Is the airport very far from here?
travel and directions.pt: O aeroporto fica muito longe daqui?

travel and directions.text: Hemos perdido el tren por cinco minutos.
travel and directions.en: We've missed the train by five minutes.
travel and directions.pt: Perdemos o trem por cinco minutos.

travel and directions.text: La farmacia está en la segunda calle a la izquierda.
travel and directions.en: The pharmacy is on the second street on the left.
travel and directions.pt: A farmácia fica na segunda rua à esquerda.

travel and directions.text: ¿A qué hora sale el próximo tren a Sevilla?
travel and directions.en: What time does the next train to Seville leave?
travel and directions.pt: A que horas sai o próximo trem para Sevilha?

travel and directions.text: Laura ha reservado un hotel cerca de la playa.
travel and directions.en: Laura has booked a hotel near the beach.
travel and directions.pt: A Laura reservou um hotel perto da praia.

travel and directions.text: Perdone, ¿cómo puedo llegar al centro?
travel and directions.en: Excuse me, how can I get to the city centre?
travel and directions.pt: Com licença, como eu chego ao centro?

travel and directions.text: Cruce la plaza y el banco está enfrente.
travel and directions.en: Cross the square and the bank is opposite.
travel and directions.pt: Atravesse a praça e o banco fica em frente.

travel and directions.text: El vuelo a Londres sale con una hora de retraso.
travel and directions.en: The flight to London is leaving an hour late.
travel and directions.pt: O voo para Londres está saindo com uma hora de atraso.

travel and directions.text: ¿Hay un cajero automático por aquí cerca?
travel and directions.en: Is there a cash machine near here?
travel and directions.pt: Tem um caixa eletrônico aqui perto?

travel and directions.text: En agosto vamos a viajar a Mallorca.
travel and directions.en: In August we're going to travel to Majorca.
travel and directions.pt: Em agosto vamos viajar para Maiorca.

travel and directions.text: Necesito un mapa de la ciudad, por favor.
travel and directions.en: I need a map of the city, please.
travel and directions.pt: Preciso de um mapa da cidade, por favor.

travel and directions.text: Tardamos dos horas en llegar a Valencia.
travel and directions.en: It took us two hours to get to Valencia.
travel and directions.pt: Levamos duas horas para chegar a Valência.

travel and directions.text: ¿Este autobús para cerca del hospital central?
travel and directions.en: Does this bus stop near the central hospital?
travel and directions.pt: Este ônibus para perto do hospital central?

travel and directions.text: La oficina de turismo abre a las nueve.
travel and directions.en: The tourist office opens at nine.
travel and directions.pt: O centro de informações turísticas abre às nove.

travel and directions.text: Al final de la calle, gire a la izquierda.
travel and directions.en: At the end of the street, turn left.
travel and directions.pt: No final da rua, vire à esquerda.

travel and directions.text: ¿Puedo dejar la maleta en la recepción?
travel and directions.en: Can I leave my suitcase at reception?
travel and directions.pt: Posso deixar a mala na recepção?

travel and directions.text: Mis padres viajaron a México el año pasado.
travel and directions.en: My parents travelled to Mexico last year.
travel and directions.pt: Meus pais viajaram para o México no ano passado.

travel and directions.text: El hotel está a diez minutos andando.
travel and directions.en: The hotel is a ten-minute walk away.
travel and directions.pt: O hotel fica a dez minutos a pé.

travel and directions.text: Me he perdido, ¿me puede ayudar?
travel and directions.en: I'm lost; can you help me?
travel and directions.pt: Eu me perdi, pode me ajudar?

travel and directions.text: ¿Dónde se compran los billetes de metro?
travel and directions.en: Where do you buy metro tickets?
travel and directions.pt: Onde se compram os bilhetes de metrô?

travel and directions.text: Vamos a alquilar un coche para tres días.
travel and directions.en: We're going to rent a car for three days.
travel and directions.pt: Vamos alugar um carro por três dias.

travel and directions.text: El tren a Bilbao sale del andén cuatro.
travel and directions.en: The train to Bilbao leaves from platform four.
travel and directions.pt: O trem para Bilbao sai da plataforma quatro.

travel and directions.text: Hemos visitado el castillo esta mañana.
travel and directions.en: We visited the castle this morning.
travel and directions.pt: Visitamos o castelo hoje de manhã.

travel and directions.text: ¿Cuántas paradas hay hasta la plaza Mayor?
travel and directions.en: How many stops are there to the Plaza Mayor?
travel and directions.pt: Quantas paradas tem até a Plaza Mayor?

travel and directions.text: Pase el puente y siga por esa avenida.
travel and directions.en: Go over the bridge and carry on along that avenue.
travel and directions.pt: Passe a ponte e siga por essa avenida.

travel and directions.text: Javier siempre viaja con una mochila pequeña.
travel and directions.en: Javier always travels with a small backpack.
travel and directions.pt: O Javier sempre viaja com uma mochila pequena.

travel and directions.text: ¿Tiene una habitación doble para esta noche?
travel and directions.en: Do you have a double room for tonight?
travel and directions.pt: Você tem um quarto duplo para esta noite?

travel and directions.text: El taxi nos dejó en la puerta del hotel.
travel and directions.en: The taxi dropped us at the hotel door.
travel and directions.pt: O táxi nos deixou na porta do hotel.

travel and directions.text: La playa está bastante lejos del centro.
travel and directions.en: The beach is quite far from the centre.
travel and directions.pt: A praia fica bem longe do centro.

travel and directions.text: ¿Necesito pasaporte para viajar a Francia?
travel and directions.en: Do I need a passport to travel to France?
travel and directions.pt: Preciso de passaporte para viajar para a França?

travel and directions.text: Primero tome la línea dos y luego la cinco.
travel and directions.en: First take line two and then line five.
travel and directions.pt: Primeiro pegue a linha dois e depois a cinco.

travel and directions.text: Este fin de semana vamos a ir a la montaña.
travel and directions.en: This weekend we're going to go to the mountains.
travel and directions.pt: Neste fim de semana vamos para as montanhas.

travel and directions.text: El avión aterrizó en Madrid a medianoche.
travel and directions.en: The plane landed in Madrid at midnight.
travel and directions.pt: O avião pousou em Madri à meia-noite.

travel and directions.text: ¿A qué hora es el desayuno en el hotel?
travel and directions.en: What time is breakfast at the hotel?
travel and directions.pt: A que horas é o café da manhã no hotel?

shopping.text: ¿Cuánto cuesta esta camiseta azul de algodón?
shopping.en: How much is this blue cotton T-shirt?
shopping.pt: Quanto custa esta camiseta azul de algodão?

shopping.text: ¿Tiene estos zapatos en la talla cuarenta?
shopping.en: Do you have these shoes in a size forty?
shopping.pt: Você tem estes sapatos no tamanho quarenta?

shopping.text: Ayer compré un abrigo nuevo en las rebajas.
shopping.en: Yesterday I bought a new coat in the sales.
shopping.pt: Ontem comprei um casaco novo na liquidação.

shopping.text: ¿Dónde están los probadores, por favor?
shopping.en: Where are the fitting rooms, please?
shopping.pt: Onde ficam os provadores, por favor?

shopping.text: Estos pantalones me quedan un poco grandes.
shopping.en: These trousers are a bit big on me.
shopping.pt: Esta calça está um pouco grande para mim.

shopping.text: Voy a comprar pan y leche en el supermercado.
shopping.en: I'm going to buy bread and milk at the supermarket.
shopping.pt: Vou comprar pão e leite no supermercado.

shopping.text: ¿Me da un kilo de tomates, por favor?
shopping.en: Can I have a kilo of tomatoes, please?
shopping.pt: Me dá um quilo de tomates, por favor?

shopping.text: Ana se ha comprado un bolso muy bonito.
shopping.en: Ana has bought herself a very nice bag.
shopping.pt: A Ana comprou uma bolsa muito bonita.

shopping.text: ¿Aceptan tarjeta o solo pagos en efectivo?
shopping.en: Do you take cards or only cash?
shopping.pt: Vocês aceitam cartão ou só dinheiro?

shopping.text: Esa chaqueta es demasiado cara para mí.
shopping.en: That jacket is too expensive for me.
shopping.pt: Essa jaqueta é cara demais para mim.

shopping.text: Quería devolver este jersey, es pequeño.
shopping.en: I'd like to return this jumper; it's too small.
shopping.pt: Eu queria devolver este suéter, está pequeno.

shopping.text: ¿Tiene usted el ticket de la compra?
shopping.en: Do you have the receipt?
shopping.pt: Você tem o comprovante da compra?

shopping.text: El mercado abre todos los días menos el domingo.
shopping.en: The market opens every day except Sunday.
shopping.pt: O mercado abre todos os dias, menos domingo.

shopping.text: ¿Hay este vestido en otro color?
shopping.en: Does this dress come in another colour?
shopping.pt: Tem este vestido em outra cor?

shopping.text: Hoy hay un descuento del veinte por ciento.
shopping.en: Today there's a twenty percent discount.
shopping.pt: Hoje tem um desconto de vinte por cento.

shopping.text: Mi hermano va a comprar un móvil nuevo.
shopping.en: My brother is going to buy a new mobile phone.
shopping.pt: Meu irmão vai comprar um celular novo.

shopping.text: ¿Me lo puede envolver para regalo?
shopping.en: Can you gift-wrap it for me?
shopping.pt: Pode embrulhar para presente?

shopping.text: He gastado demasiado dinero este mes.
shopping.en: I've spent too much money this month.
shopping.pt: Gastei dinheiro demais este mês.

shopping.text: Necesito una bolsa de plástico, ¿cuánto cuesta?
shopping.en: I need a plastic bag; how much is it?
shopping.pt: Preciso de uma sacola plástica, quanto custa?

shopping.text: La tienda de ropa está en la primera planta.
shopping.en: The clothes shop is on the first floor.
shopping.pt: A loja de roupas fica no primeiro andar.

shopping.text: ¿De dónde son estas naranjas tan grandes?
shopping.en: Where are these big oranges from?
shopping.pt: De onde são essas laranjas tão grandes?

shopping.text: Compramos los regalos de Navidad por internet.
shopping.en: We bought the Christmas presents online.
shopping.pt: Compramos os presentes de Natal pela internet.

shopping.text: No necesito ayuda, solo estoy mirando, gracias.
shopping.en: I don't need any help, I'm just looking, thanks.
shopping.pt: Não preciso de ajuda, só estou olhando, obrigado.

shopping.text: Este reloj cuesta ciento cincuenta euros.
shopping.en: This watch costs a hundred and fifty euros.
shopping.pt: Este relógio custa cento e cinquenta euros.

shopping.text: ¿A qué hora cierra el centro comercial?
shopping.en: What time does the shopping centre close?
shopping.pt: A que horas fecha o shopping?

shopping.text: Me llevo las dos camisas blancas.
shopping.en: I'll take the two white shirts.
shopping.pt: Vou levar as duas camisas brancas.

shopping.text: Carmen fue de compras con su madre el sábado.
shopping.en: Carmen went shopping with her mother on Saturday.
shopping.pt: A Carmen foi fazer compras com a mãe no sábado.

shopping.text: Perdone, ¿me puede cobrar aquí, por favor?
shopping.en: Excuse me, can I pay here, please?
shopping.pt: Com licença, posso pagar aqui, por favor?

shopping.text: Se me ha olvidado la lista de la compra.
shopping.en: I've forgotten the shopping list.
shopping.pt: Esqueci a lista de compras.

shopping.text: Las fresas están muy baratas esta semana.
shopping.en: Strawberries are very cheap this week.
shopping.pt: Os morangos estão muito baratos esta semana.

shopping.text: ¿Tienen esta falda en una talla más pequeña?
shopping.en: Do you have this skirt in a smaller size?
shopping.pt: Vocês têm esta saia em um tamanho menor?

shopping.text: Vamos a comprar muebles para el salón.
shopping.en: We're going to buy furniture for the living room.
shopping.pt: Vamos comprar móveis para a sala.

shopping.text: Doscientos gramos de jamón serrano, por favor.
shopping.en: Two hundred grams of serrano ham, please.
shopping.pt: Duzentos gramas de presunto serrano, por favor.

shopping.text: El dependiente fue muy amable con nosotros.
shopping.en: The shop assistant was very kind to us.
shopping.pt: O vendedor foi muito gentil com a gente.

shopping.text: ¿Puedo probarme estas botas negras un momento?
shopping.en: Can I try on these black boots for a moment?
shopping.pt: Posso experimentar estas botas pretas um minutinho?

shopping.text: No me queda dinero en efectivo.
shopping.en: I don't have any cash left.
shopping.pt: Não tenho mais dinheiro em espécie.

shopping.text: La panadería de mi barrio vende pan muy rico.
shopping.en: The bakery in my neighbourhood sells really good bread.
shopping.pt: A padaria do meu bairro vende um pão muito gostoso.

shopping.text: Perfecto, ¿y cuánto es todo junto?
shopping.en: Great, and how much is it all together?
shopping.pt: Perfeito, e quanto dá tudo junto?

shopping.text: Prefiero comprar la fruta en el mercado.
shopping.en: I prefer to buy fruit at the market.
shopping.pt: Prefiro comprar frutas no mercado.

shopping.text: Esta mañana he comprado unas gafas de sol.
shopping.en: This morning I bought some sunglasses.
shopping.pt: Hoje de manhã comprei uns óculos de sol.

work and meetings.text: La reunión empieza a las diez en punto.
work and meetings.en: The meeting starts at ten o'clock sharp.
work and meetings.pt: A reunião começa às dez em ponto.

work and meetings.text: Hoy trabajo desde casa todo el día.
work and meetings.en: Today I'm working from home all day.
work and meetings.pt: Hoje trabalho de casa o dia todo.

work and meetings.text: ¿Has enviado el informe al jefe?
work and meetings.en: Have you sent the report to the boss?
work and meetings.pt: Você enviou o relatório para o chefe?

work and meetings.text: Mañana vamos a presentar el proyecto al cliente.
work and meetings.en: Tomorrow we're going to present the project to the client.
work and meetings.pt: Amanhã vamos apresentar o projeto ao cliente.

work and meetings.text: Mi compañera Elena trabaja en el departamento de ventas.
work and meetings.en: My colleague Elena works in the sales department.
work and meetings.pt: Minha colega Elena trabalha no departamento de vendas.

work and meetings.text: La reunión de ayer duró casi tres horas.
work and meetings.en: Yesterday's meeting lasted almost three hours.
work and meetings.pt: A reunião de ontem durou quase três horas.

work and meetings.text: ¿Podemos cambiar la reunión al jueves?
work and meetings.en: Can we move the meeting to Thursday?
work and meetings.pt: Podemos mudar a reunião para quinta-feira?

work and meetings.text: Empiezo a trabajar a las ocho y media.
work and meetings.en: I start work at half past eight.
work and meetings.pt: Começo a trabalhar às oito e meia.

work and meetings.text: Esta semana tengo mucho trabajo en la oficina.
work and meetings.en: This week I have a lot of work at the office.
work and meetings.pt: Esta semana tenho muito trabalho no escritório.

work and meetings.text: El director ha llegado tarde a la reunión.
work and meetings.en: The director arrived late to the meeting.
work and meetings.pt: O diretor chegou atrasado à reunião.

work and meetings.text: ¿Quién va a tomar notas en la reunión?
work and meetings.en: Who's going to take notes in the meeting?
work and meetings.pt: Quem vai fazer as anotações na reunião?

work and meetings.text: Necesito imprimir estos documentos antes de las doce.
work and meetings.en: I need to print these documents before twelve.
work and meetings.pt: Preciso imprimir estes documentos antes do meio-dia.

work and meetings.text: Raúl busca trabajo como profesor de inglés.
work and meetings.en: Raúl is looking for work as an English teacher.
work and meetings.pt: O Raúl está procurando emprego como professor de inglês.

work and meetings.text: Tengo una entrevista de trabajo el lunes.
work and meetings.en: I have a job interview on Monday.
work and meetings.pt: Tenho uma entrevista de emprego na segunda-feira.

work and meetings.text: El ordenador de la oficina no funciona bien.
work and meetings.en: The office computer isn't working properly.
work and meetings.pt: O computador do escritório não está funcionando bem.

work and meetings.text: Hemos terminado el proyecto antes de tiempo.
work and meetings.en: We've finished the project ahead of schedule.
work and meetings.pt: Terminamos o projeto antes do prazo.

work and meetings.text: ¿A qué hora sales del trabajo hoy?
work and meetings.en: What time do you finish work today?
work and meetings.pt: A que horas você sai do trabalho hoje?

work and meetings.text: Mi jefa es muy simpática y trabajadora.
work and meetings.en: My boss is very nice and hard-working.
work and meetings.pt: Minha chefe é muito simpática e trabalhadora.

work and meetings.text: Voy a llamar al cliente después de comer.
work and meetings.en: I'm going to call the client after lunch.
work and meetings.pt: Vou ligar para o cliente depois do almoço.

work and meetings.text: En mi empresa trabajan unas cincuenta personas.
work and meetings.en: About fifty people work at my company.
work and meetings.pt: Na minha empresa trabalham umas cinquenta pessoas.

work and meetings.text: ¿Puedes mandarme la presentación por correo?
work and meetings.en: Can you send me the presentation by email?
work and meetings.pt: Pode me mandar a apresentação por e-mail?

work and meetings.text: El año pasado cambié de trabajo.
work and meetings.en: Last year I changed jobs.
work and meetings.pt: No ano passado mudei de emprego.

work and meetings.text: La sala de reuniones está en el tercer piso.
work and meetings.en: The meeting room is on the third floor.
work and meetings.pt: A sala de reuniões fica no terceiro andar.

work and meetings.text: Hoy tenemos una videollamada con el equipo de Barcelona.
work and meetings.en: Today we have a video call with the Barcelona team.
work and meetings.pt: Hoje temos uma videochamada com a equipe de Barcelona.

work and meetings.text: No he tenido tiempo de leer tu correo.
work and meetings.en: I haven't had time to read your email.
work and meetings.pt: Não tive tempo de ler o seu e-mail.

work and meetings.text: ¿Cuántos días de vacaciones tienes al año?
work and meetings.en: How many days of holiday do you get a year?
work and meetings.pt: Quantos dias de férias você tem por ano?

work and meetings.text: Pablo va a trabajar en Londres el próximo año.
work and meetings.en: Pablo is going to work in London next year.
work and meetings.pt: O Pablo vai trabalhar em Londres no ano que vem.

work and meetings.text: Siempre tomo un café con mis compañeros a las once.
work and meetings.en: I always have a coffee with my colleagues at eleven.
work and meetings.pt: Sempre tomo um café com meus colegas às onze.

work and meetings.text: La impresora no tiene papel otra vez.
work and meetings.en: The printer is out of paper again.
work and meetings.pt: A impressora está sem papel de novo.

work and meetings.text: ¿Te viene bien una reunión a las cuatro?
work and meetings.en: Does a meeting at four suit you?
work and meetings.pt: Uma reunião às quatro fica bom para você?

work and meetings.text: Ayer salí de la oficina muy tarde.
work and meetings.en: Yesterday I left the office very late.
work and meetings.pt: Ontem saí do escritório muito tarde.

work and meetings.text: Trabajo en un hospital como enfermera.
work and meetings.en: I work in a hospital as a nurse.
work and meetings.pt: Trabalho em um hospital como enfermeira.

work and meetings.text: El jefe nos ha felicitado por el buen trabajo.
work and meetings.en: The boss congratulated us on the good work.
work and meetings.pt: O chefe nos parabenizou pelo bom trabalho.

work and meetings.text: Tenemos que terminar esto antes del viernes.
work and meetings.en: We have to finish this before Friday.
work and meetings.pt: Temos que terminar isso antes de sexta-feira.

work and meetings.text: ¿Quién es la nueva compañera de tu equipo?
work and meetings.en: Who's the new colleague on your team?
work and meetings.pt: Quem é a nova colega da sua equipe?

work and meetings.text: Mañana voy a pedir un día libre.
work and meetings.en: Tomorrow I'm going to ask for a day off.
work and meetings.pt: Amanhã vou pedir um dia de folga.

work and meetings.text: Han cancelado la reunión de esta tarde.
work and meetings.en: This afternoon's meeting has been cancelled.
work and meetings.pt: Cancelaram a reunião de hoje à tarde.

work and meetings.text: Mi oficina está muy cerca de la estación.
work and meetings.en: My office is very close to the station.
work and meetings.pt: Meu escritório fica muito perto da estação.

work and meetings.text: ¿Has hablado ya con el nuevo director?
work and meetings.en: Have you already spoken to the new director?
work and meetings.pt: Você já falou com o novo diretor?

work and meetings.text: Los viernes salimos del trabajo a las tres.
work and meetings.en: On Fridays we finish work at three.
work and meetings.pt: Às sextas saímos do trabalho às três.

family and friends.text: Tengo dos hermanos y una hermana mayor.
family and friends.en: I have two brothers and an older sister.
family and friends.pt: Tenho dois irmãos e uma irmã mais velha.

family and friends.text: Mi abuela cumple noventa años este domingo.
family and friends.en: My grandmother turns ninety this Sunday.
family and friends.pt: Minha avó faz noventa anos neste domingo.

family and friends.text: Ayer cené con unos amigos del colegio.
family and friends.en: Yesterday I had dinner with some school friends.
family and friends.pt: Ontem jantei com uns amigos da escola.

family and friends.text: ¿Cuántos años tiene tu hijo pequeño?
family and friends.en: How old is your youngest son?
family and friends.pt: Quantos anos tem o seu filho mais novo?

family and friends.text: Mis primos viven en un pueblo de Asturias.
family and friends.en: My cousins live in a village in Asturias.
family and friends.pt: Meus primos moram em uma cidadezinha nas Astúrias.

family and friends.text: Lucía y Daniel se casaron el año pasado.
family and friends.en: Lucía and Daniel got married last year.
family and friends.pt: A Lucía e o Daniel se casaram no ano passado.

family and friends.text: Esta noche vamos a cenar en casa de mis padres.
family and friends.en: Tonight we're going to have dinner at my parents' house.
family and friends.pt: Hoje à noite vamos jantar na casa dos meus pais.

family and friends.text: Mi mejor amiga se llama Sara.
family and friends.en: My best friend's name is Sara.
family and friends.pt: Minha melhor amiga se chama Sara.

family and friends.text: Mi padre es muy alto y tiene el pelo gris.
family and friends.en: My father is very tall and has grey hair.
family and friends.pt: Meu pai é muito alto e tem cabelo grisalho.

family and friends.text: Mi tío trabaja de taxista en Madrid.
family and friends.en: My uncle works as a taxi driver in Madrid.
family and friends.pt: Meu tio trabalha como taxista em Madri.

family and friends.text: Hemos tenido un bebé, se llama Hugo.
family and friends.en: We've had a baby; his name is Hugo.
family and friends.pt: Tivemos um bebê, ele se chama Hugo.

family and friends.text: Los domingos comemos todos juntos en casa de la abuela.
family and friends.en: On Sundays we all have lunch together at Grandma's.
family and friends.pt: Aos domingos almoçamos todos juntos na casa da vovó.

family and friends.text: Conocí a mi marido en la universidad.
family and friends.en: I met my husband at university.
family and friends.pt: Conheci meu marido na faculdade.

family and friends.text: Mi hermana pequeña estudia Medicina en Salamanca.
family and friends.en: My younger sister studies medicine in Salamanca.
family and friends.pt: Minha irmã mais nova estuda medicina em Salamanca.

family and friends.text: ¿Vas a invitar a tus amigos a la fiesta?
family and friends.en: Are you going to invite your friends to the party?
family and friends.pt: Você vai convidar seus amigos para a festa?

family and friends.text: Mi sobrino tiene cinco años y es muy gracioso.
family and friends.en: My nephew is five and he's very funny.
family and friends.pt: Meu sobrinho tem cinco anos e é muito engraçado.

family and friends.text: Carlos es el novio de mi prima Irene.
family and friends.en: Carlos is my cousin Irene's boyfriend.
family and friends.pt: O Carlos é o namorado da minha prima Irene.

family and friends.text: Ayer fuimos al cumpleaños de mi cuñado Andrés.
family and friends.en: Yesterday we went to my brother-in-law Andrés's birthday.
family and friends.pt: Ontem fomos ao aniversário do meu cunhado Andrés.

family and friends.text: Mis amigos me han preparado una fiesta sorpresa.
family and friends.en: My friends have organised a surprise party for me.
family and friends.pt: Meus amigos prepararam uma festa surpresa para mim.

family and friends.text: Mis abuelos tienen una casa en el campo.
family and friends.en: My grandparents have a house in the countryside.
family and friends.pt: Meus avós têm uma casa no campo.

family and friends.text: Mi hijo se parece mucho a su padre.
family and friends.en: My son looks a lot like his father.
family and friends.pt: Meu filho se parece muito com o pai.

family and friends.text: ¿Cómo se llama tu novia y de dónde es?
family and friends.en: What's your girlfriend's name and where is she from?
family and friends.pt: Como se chama a sua namorada e de onde ela é?

family and friends.text: Mi madre y yo hablamos casi todos los días.
family and friends.en: My mother and I talk almost every day.
family and friends.pt: Eu e minha mãe conversamos quase todos os dias.

family and friends.text: Mi familia es pequeña, pero muy unida.
family and friends.en: My family is small but very close.
family and friends.pt: Minha família é pequena, mas muito unida.

family and friends.text: El próximo fin de semana viene mi hermano de Berlín.
family and friends.en: Next weekend my brother is coming from Berlin.
family and friends.pt: No próximo fim de semana meu irmão vem de Berlim.

family and friends.text: Mis padres llevan treinta años casados.
family and friends.en: My parents have been married for thirty years.
family and friends.pt: Meus pais estão casados há trinta anos.

family and friends.text: Conozco a Marcos desde hace veinte años.
family and friends.en: I've known Marcos for twenty years.
family and friends.pt: Conheço o Marcos há vinte anos.

family and friends.text: Mi hermano mayor tiene dos hijas gemelas.
family and friends.en: My older brother has twin daughters.
family and friends.pt: Meu irmão mais velho tem duas filhas gêmeas.

family and friends.text: ¿Quieres venir a comer con mi familia el domingo?
family and friends.en: Do you want to come for lunch with my family on Sunday?
family and friends.pt: Quer vir almoçar com a minha família no domingo?

family and friends.text: Mi amiga Rosa vive ahora en Alemania.
family and friends.en: My friend Rosa lives in Germany now.
family and friends.pt: Minha amiga Rosa mora agora na Alemanha.

family and friends.text: Anoche mis hijos se acostaron muy tarde.
family and friends.en: Last night my children went to bed very late.
family and friends.pt: Ontem à noite meus filhos foram dormir muito tarde.

family and friends.text: Mi cuñada es muy simpática y divertida.
family and friends.en: My sister-in-law is very nice and fun.
family and friends.pt: Minha cunhada é muito simpática e divertida.

family and friends.text: Vamos a celebrar el cumpleaños de papá en un restaurante.
family and friends.en: We're going to celebrate Dad's birthday at a restaurant.
family and friends.pt: Vamos comemorar o aniversário do papai em um restaurante.

family and friends.text: Este verano mis nietos van a pasar un mes conmigo.
family and friends.en: This summer my grandchildren are going to spend a month with me.
family and friends.pt: Neste verão meus netos vão passar um mês comigo.

family and friends.text: ¿Has visto a Jorge y a Clara últimamente?
family and friends.en: Have you seen Jorge and Clara lately?
family and friends.pt: Você viu o Jorge e a Clara ultimamente?

family and friends.text: Mi mujer y yo tenemos tres hijos.
family and friends.en: My wife and I have three children.
family and friends.pt: Eu e minha esposa temos três filhos.

family and friends.text: Mis amigos siempre me ayudan cuando tengo problemas.
family and friends.en: My friends always help me when I have problems.
family and friends.pt: Meus amigos sempre me ajudam quando tenho problemas.

family and friends.text: Mi abuelo me enseñó a jugar al ajedrez.
family and friends.en: My grandfather taught me to play chess.
family and friends.pt: Meu avô me ensinou a jogar xadrez.

family and friends.text: ¿A qué se dedica tu hermano?
family and friends.en: What does your brother do for a living?
family and friends.pt: O que o seu irmão faz da vida?

health and the doctor.text: Me duele mucho la cabeza desde esta mañana.
health and the doctor.en: I've had a bad headache since this morning.
health and the doctor.pt: Estou com muita dor de cabeça desde hoje de manhã.

health and the doctor.text: Tengo fiebre y me duele la garganta.
health and the doctor.en: I have a temperature and a sore throat.
health and the doctor.pt: Estou com febre e com dor de garganta.

health and the doctor.text: ¿Desde cuándo tiene usted estos síntomas?
health and the doctor.en: How long have you had these symptoms?
health and the doctor.pt: Desde quando o senhor tem esses sintomas?

health and the doctor.text: El médico me ha recetado unas pastillas.
health and the doctor.en: The doctor has prescribed me some pills.
health and the doctor.pt: O médico me receitou uns comprimidos.

health and the doctor.text: Tome este jarabe tres veces al día.
health and the doctor.en: Take this syrup three times a day.
health and the doctor.pt: Tome este xarope três vezes ao dia.

health and the doctor.text: Ayer fui al dentista por un dolor de muelas.
health and the doctor.en: Yesterday I went to the dentist because of a toothache.
health and the doctor.pt: Ontem fui ao dentista por causa de uma dor de dente.

health and the doctor.text: Creo que estoy resfriado, no paro de estornudar.
health and the doctor.en: I think I've got a cold; I can't stop sneezing.
health and the doctor.pt: Acho que estou resfriado, não paro de espirrar.

health and the doctor.text: ¿Dónde está la farmacia más cercana?
health and the doctor.en: Where's the nearest pharmacy?
health and the doctor.pt: Onde fica a farmácia mais próxima?

health and the doctor.text: Mi hijo tiene tos desde hace tres días.
health and the doctor.en: My son has had a cough for three days.
health and the doctor.pt: Meu filho está com tosse há três dias.

health and the doctor.text: Tienes que beber mucha agua y descansar.
health and the doctor.en: You have to drink lots of water and rest.
health and the doctor.pt: Você tem que beber muita água e descansar.

health and the doctor.text: Me he roto el brazo jugando al fútbol.
health and the doctor.en: I broke my arm playing football.
health and the doctor.pt: Quebrei o braço jogando futebol.

health and the doctor.text: Voy a pedir cita con el médico de cabecera.
health and the doctor.en: I'm going to make an appointment with my GP.
health and the doctor.pt: Vou marcar uma consulta com o clínico geral.

health and the doctor.text: ¿Es usted alérgico a algún medicamento?
health and the doctor.en: Are you allergic to any medication?
health and the doctor.pt: O senhor é alérgico a algum remédio?

health and the doctor.text: Hoy no voy a trabajar porque estoy enferma.
health and the doctor.en: I'm not going to work today because I'm ill.
health and the doctor.pt: Hoje não vou trabalhar porque estou doente.

health and the doctor.text: El enfermero me ha tomado la tensión.
health and the doctor.en: The nurse has taken my blood pressure.
health and the doctor.pt: O enfermeiro mediu a minha pressão.

health and the doctor.text: Abra la boca y saque la lengua, por favor.
health and the doctor.en: Open your mouth and stick out your tongue, please.
health and the doctor.pt: Abra a boca e mostre a língua, por favor.

health and the doctor.text: Me duele la espalda cuando estoy mucho tiempo sentado.
health and the doctor.en: My back hurts when I sit for a long time.
health and the doctor.pt: Minhas costas doem quando fico muito tempo sentado.

health and the doctor.text: Tiene que hacer más ejercicio y comer menos dulces.
health and the doctor.en: You need to exercise more and eat fewer sweets.
health and the doctor.pt: O senhor precisa fazer mais exercício e comer menos doces.

health and the doctor.text: Ana se ha torcido el tobillo esta tarde.
health and the doctor.en: Ana sprained her ankle this afternoon.
health and the doctor.pt: A Ana torceu o tornozelo hoje à tarde.

health and the doctor.text: ¿Cuántas pastillas tengo que tomar al día?
health and the doctor.en: How many pills do I have to take a day?
health and the doctor.pt: Quantos comprimidos eu tenho que tomar por dia?

health and the doctor.text: Ya me encuentro mucho mejor, gracias.
health and the doctor.en: I already feel much better, thanks.
health and the doctor.pt: Já estou me sentindo muito melhor, obrigado.

health and the doctor.text: El hospital está abierto las veinticuatro horas.
health and the doctor.en: The hospital is open twenty-four hours a day.
health and the doctor.pt: O hospital fica aberto vinte e quatro horas.

health and the doctor.text: Tengo el estómago mal desde anoche.
health and the doctor.en: I've had an upset stomach since last night.
health and the doctor.pt: Estou com o estômago ruim desde ontem à noite.

health and the doctor.text: No puede tomar alcohol con este antibiótico.
health and the doctor.en: You can't drink alcohol with this antibiotic.
health and the doctor.pt: O senhor não pode beber álcool com este antibiótico.

health and the doctor.text: Mi abuelo va al médico todos los meses.
health and the doctor.en: My grandfather goes to the doctor every month.
health and the doctor.pt: Meu avô vai ao médico todo mês.

health and the doctor.text: Buenos días, dígame, ¿qué le pasa exactamente?
health and the doctor.en: Good morning, tell me, what exactly is the problem?
health and the doctor.pt: Bom dia, me diga, o que o senhor está sentindo exatamente?

health and the doctor.text: Necesito un análisis de sangre la semana que viene.
health and the doctor.en: I need a blood test next week.
health and the doctor.pt: Preciso fazer um exame de sangue na semana que vem.

health and the doctor.text: Me he cortado el dedo con un cuchillo.
health and the doctor.en: I've cut my finger with a knife.
health and the doctor.pt: Cortei o dedo com uma faca.

health and the doctor.text: Duermo muy mal y estoy siempre cansado.
health and the doctor.en: I sleep very badly and I'm always tired.
health and the doctor.pt: Durmo muito mal e estou sempre cansado.

health and the doctor.text: Este verano voy a dejar de fumar.
health and the doctor.en: This summer I'm going to give up smoking.
health and the doctor.pt: Neste verão vou parar de fumar.

health and the doctor.text: La doctora Gómez atiende por las mañanas.
health and the doctor.en: Doctor Gómez sees patients in the mornings.
health and the doctor.pt: A doutora Gómez atende de manhã.

health and the doctor.text: ¿Tiene algo para el dolor de cabeza?
health and the doctor.en: Do you have something for a headache?
health and the doctor.pt: Você tem algo para dor de cabeça?

health and the doctor.text: Mi marido ha estado dos días en el hospital.
health and the doctor.en: My husband has been in hospital for two days.
health and the doctor.pt: Meu marido ficou dois dias no hospital.

health and the doctor.text: Tengo los ojos rojos y me pican mucho.
health and the doctor.en: My eyes are red and very itchy.
health and the doctor.pt: Estou com os olhos vermelhos e coçando muito.

health and the doctor.text: Camino una hora cada día para estar sano.
health and the doctor.en: I walk for an hour every day to stay healthy.
health and the doctor.pt: Caminho uma hora todos os dias para ter saúde.

health and the doctor.text: Le duele la rodilla cuando sube las escaleras.
health and the doctor.en: Her knee hurts when she goes up the stairs.
health and the doctor.pt: O joelho dela dói quando ela sobe as escadas.

health and the doctor.text: Hay que tomar el medicamento después de las comidas.
health and the doctor.en: The medicine has to be taken after meals.
health and the doctor.pt: É preciso tomar o remédio depois das refeições.

health and the doctor.text: Ayer me vacuné contra la gripe.
health and the doctor.en: Yesterday I got the flu jab.
health and the doctor.pt: Ontem tomei a vacina da gripe.

health and the doctor.text: ¿Necesito receta para comprar este medicamento?
health and the doctor.en: Do I need a prescription to buy this medicine?
health and the doctor.pt: Preciso de receita para comprar este remédio?

health and the doctor.text: Si tiene más fiebre, vuelva a la consulta.
health and the doctor.en: If your temperature goes up, come back to the surgery.
health and the doctor.pt: Se a febre aumentar, volte ao consultório.

weather and seasons.text: Hoy hace mucho calor en Sevilla.
weather and seasons.en: It's very hot in Seville today.
weather and seasons.pt: Hoje está fazendo muito calor em Sevilha.

weather and seasons.text: ¿Qué tiempo hace hoy en tu ciudad?
weather and seasons.en: What's the weather like in your city today?
weather and seasons.pt: Como está o tempo hoje na sua cidade?

weather and seasons.text: Ayer llovió todo el día sin parar.
weather and seasons.en: Yesterday it rained all day without stopping.
weather and seasons.pt: Ontem choveu o dia todo sem parar.

weather and seasons.text: Mañana va a nevar en la montaña.
weather and seasons.en: Tomorrow it's going to snow in the mountains.
weather and seasons.pt: Amanhã vai nevar nas montanhas.

weather and seasons.text: Me encanta la primavera porque hay muchas flores.
weather and seasons.en: I love spring because there are lots of flowers.
weather and seasons.pt: Adoro a primavera porque tem muitas flores.

weather and seasons.text: En invierno anochece muy pronto en el norte.
weather and seasons.en: In winter it gets dark very early in the north.
weather and seasons.pt: No inverno escurece muito cedo no norte.

weather and seasons.text: Coge el paraguas, que está lloviendo.
weather and seasons.en: Take the umbrella, it's raining.
weather and seasons.pt: Pega o guarda-chuva, que está chovendo.

weather and seasons.text: Hace un día precioso para ir a la playa.
weather and seasons.en: It's a beautiful day to go to the beach.
weather and seasons.pt: Está um dia lindo para ir à praia.

weather and seasons.text: Esta mañana ha hecho mucho frío.
weather and seasons.en: It was very cold this morning.
weather and seasons.pt: Hoje de manhã fez muito frio.

weather and seasons.text: En otoño las hojas de los árboles cambian de color.
weather and seasons.en: In autumn the leaves on the trees change colour.
weather and seasons.pt: No outono as folhas das árvores mudam de cor.

weather and seasons.text: ¿Cuál es tu estación del año favorita?
weather and seasons.en: What's your favourite season of the year?
weather and seasons.pt: Qual é a sua estação do ano favorita?

weather and seasons.text: Hoy estamos a treinta y cinco grados.
weather and seasons.en: It's thirty-five degrees today.
weather and seasons.pt: Hoje está fazendo trinta e cinco graus.

weather and seasons.text: Hace mucho viento en la costa esta tarde.
weather and seasons.en: It's very windy on the coast this afternoon.
weather and seasons.pt: Está ventando muito no litoral hoje à tarde.

weather and seasons.text: El fin de semana va a hacer sol.
weather and seasons.en: It's going to be sunny at the weekend.
weather and seasons.pt: No fim de semana vai fazer sol.

weather and seasons.text: En agosto hace demasiado calor para trabajar.
weather and seasons.en: In August it's too hot to work.
weather and seasons.pt: Em agosto faz calor demais para trabalhar.

weather and seasons.text: Anoche hubo una tormenta muy fuerte.
weather and seasons.en: Last night there was a very strong storm.
weather and seasons.pt: Ontem à noite teve uma tempestade muito forte.

weather and seasons.text: No me gusta nada el frío del invierno.
weather and seasons.en: I don't like the winter cold at all.
weather and seasons.pt: Não gosto nada do frio do inverno.

weather and seasons.text: Está nublado, pero hoy no va a llover.
weather and seasons.en: It's cloudy, but it isn't going to rain today.
weather and seasons.pt: Está nublado, mas hoje não vai chover.

weather and seasons.text: En Galicia llueve mucho durante todo el año.
weather and seasons.en: In Galicia it rains a lot all year round.
weather and seasons.pt: Na Galícia chove muito o ano todo.

weather and seasons.text: Ponte el abrigo, hace cinco grados fuera.
weather and seasons.en: Put your coat on, it's five degrees outside.

feelings and opinions.text: Creo que tienes toda la razón, Pedro.
feelings and opinions.en: I think you're absolutely right, Pedro.
feelings and opinions.pt: Acho que você tem toda a razão, Pedro.

feelings and opinions.text: Estoy un poco enfadado con mi compañero de piso.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm a bit angry with my flatmate.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou um pouco bravo com meu colega de apartamento.

feelings and opinions.text: Me parece una idea estupenda ir a la playa.
feelings and opinions.en: I think going to the beach is a great idea.
feelings and opinions.pt: Acho uma ótima ideia ir à praia.

feelings and opinions.text: ¿Por qué estás tan serio hoy?
feelings and opinions.en: Why are you so serious today?
feelings and opinions.pt: Por que você está tão sério hoje?

feelings and opinions.text: Ayer me sentí muy sola en casa.
feelings and opinions.en: Yesterday I felt very lonely at home.
feelings and opinions.pt: Ontem me senti muito sozinha em casa.

feelings and opinions.text: Prefiero el campo a la ciudad, es más tranquilo.
feelings and opinions.en: I prefer the countryside to the city; it's quieter.
feelings and opinions.pt: Prefiro o campo à cidade, é mais tranquilo.

feelings and opinions.text: La exposición me ha parecido muy interesante.
feelings and opinions.en: I found the exhibition very interesting.
feelings and opinions.pt: Achei a exposição muito interessante.

feelings and opinions.text: Estoy nerviosa porque mañana empiezo en la universidad.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm nervous because I start university tomorrow.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou nervosa porque amanhã começo na faculdade.

feelings and opinions.text: No me gusta nada la gente maleducada.
feelings and opinions.en: I don't like rude people at all.
feelings and opinions.pt: Não gosto nada de gente mal-educada.

feelings and opinions.text: ¡Qué sorpresa tan bonita me habéis dado!
feelings and opinions.en: What a lovely surprise you've given me!
feelings and opinions.pt: Que surpresa linda vocês me fizeram!

feelings and opinions.text: Mi madre está feliz porque viene mi hermana.
feelings and opinions.en: My mother is happy because my sister is coming.
feelings and opinions.pt: Minha mãe está feliz porque minha irmã vem.

feelings and opinions.text: Para mí, lo más importante es la familia.
feelings and opinions.en: For me, the most important thing is family.
feelings and opinions.pt: Para mim, o mais importante é a família.

feelings and opinions.text: Me aburro mucho cuando no tengo nada que hacer.
feelings and opinions.en: I get really bored when I have nothing to do.
feelings and opinions.pt: Fico muito entediado quando não tenho nada para fazer.

feelings and opinions.text: Te veo preocupado, ¿te pasa algo?
feelings and opinions.en: You look worried; is something wrong?
feelings and opinions.pt: Você parece preocupado, aconteceu alguma coisa?

feelings and opinions.text: Sinceramente, la comida del hotel no me gustó.
feelings and opinions.en: Honestly, I didn't like the hotel food.
feelings and opinions.pt: Sinceramente, não gostei da comida do hotel.

feelings and opinions.text: Me encanta pasar tiempo con mis amigos.
feelings and opinions.en: I love spending time with my friends.
feelings and opinions.pt: Adoro passar tempo com meus amigos.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Buenos días, señora Pilar, ¿cómo está usted?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Good morning, Mrs Pilar, how are you?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Bom dia, dona Pilar, como a senhora está?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Hola, vecino, ¿qué tal el fin de semana?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Hi, neighbour, how was your weekend?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Oi, vizinho, como foi o fim de semana?

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Has visto que han abierto una panadería nueva?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you seen that a new bakery has opened?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você viu que abriram uma padaria nova?

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Su perro ya está mejor de la pata?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Is your dog's paw better now?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: A pata do seu cachorro já está melhor?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Mañana van a arreglar el ascensor por fin.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Tomorrow they're finally going to fix the lift.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Amanhã finalmente vão consertar o elevador.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Usted también vive en el cuarto piso?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Do you live on the fourth floor too?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor também mora no quarto andar?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Anoche hubo mucho ruido en el edificio.
small talk with a neighbour.en: There was a lot of noise in the building last night.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Ontem à noite teve muito barulho no prédio.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Sus hijos ya han vuelto de vacaciones?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have your children come back from holiday yet?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Seus filhos já voltaram das férias?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Perdone, ¿me puede dejar un poco de sal?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Excuse me, could you lend me a bit of salt?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Com licença, pode me emprestar um pouco de sal?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Ha llegado un paquete para usted esta mañana.
small talk with a neighbour.en: A parcel arrived for you this morning.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Chegou um pacote para o senhor hoje de manhã.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¡Qué bonitas están sus plantas este año!
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your plants look so beautiful this year!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Como estão bonitas as suas plantas este ano!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Nos vemos en la reunión de vecinos del jueves.
small talk with a neighbour.en: See you at Thursday's residents' meeting.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: A gente se vê na reunião de condomínio de quinta.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Sabe a qué hora pasa el cartero?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Do you know what time the postman comes?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor sabe a que horas passa o carteiro?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Mi marido y yo nos mudamos aquí en marzo.
small talk with a neighbour.en: My husband and I moved here in March.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Eu e meu marido nos mudamos para cá em março.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Lleva mucho tiempo viviendo en este barrio?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you been living in this neighbourhood long?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor mora neste bairro há muito tempo?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Este barrio es muy tranquilo y agradable.
small talk with a neighbour.en: This neighbourhood is very quiet and pleasant.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Este bairro é muito tranquilo e agradável.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Voy a estar fuera unos días, ¿me riega las plantas?
small talk with a neighbour.en: I'm going to be away for a few days; could you water my plants?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Vou ficar fora uns dias, pode regar minhas plantas?

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Ha oído que los del quinto se van?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you heard that the people on the fifth floor are leaving?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor ficou sabendo que os do quinto andar vão se mudar?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Su hija está muy alta, ¡cómo crece!
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your daughter is so tall, she's growing so fast!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Sua filha está muito alta, como ela cresce!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Esta mañana he visto a su madre en el mercado.
small talk with a neighbour.en: This morning I saw your mother at the market.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Hoje de manhã vi a sua mãe no mercado.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Qué tal le fue la operación a su marido?
small talk with a neighbour.en: How did your husband's operation go?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Como foi a cirurgia do seu marido?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Siento mucho el ruido de la fiesta de ayer.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I'm very sorry about the noise from yesterday's party.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Desculpe pelo barulho da festa de ontem.

small talk with a neighbour.text: El portero dice que mañana no hay agua caliente.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The caretaker says there's no hot water tomorrow.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O porteiro diz que amanhã não vai ter água quente.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¡Buen fin de semana, y saludos a su familia!
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have a good weekend, and say hello to your family!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Bom fim de semana, e lembranças para a sua família!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Si va al supermercado, la acompaño.
small talk with a neighbour.en: If you're going to the supermarket, I'll come with you.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Se a senhora vai ao supermercado, eu vou junto.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Hace mucho que no le veo por aquí.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I haven't seen you around here for a long time.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Faz tempo que não vejo o senhor por aqui.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Mis hijos van al mismo colegio que los suyos.
small talk with a neighbour.en: My children go to the same school as yours.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Meus filhos estudam na mesma escola que os seus.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Le ayudo con las bolsas de la compra?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Shall I help you with your shopping bags?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Posso ajudar a senhora com as sacolas de compras?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Gracias por recoger mi paquete ayer.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Thanks for picking up my parcel yesterday.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Obrigado por pegar o meu pacote ontem.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Las fiestas del barrio empiezan este viernes.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The neighbourhood festival starts this Friday.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: A festa do bairro começa nesta sexta.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Ha visto usted un gato gris por la escalera?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you seen a grey cat on the stairs?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor viu um gato cinza pela escada?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Ya están las luces de Navidad en la calle.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The Christmas lights are already up in the street.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: As luzes de Natal já estão na rua.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Mi coche no arranca, ¿tiene usted cables?
small talk with a neighbour.en: My car won't start; do you have jump leads?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Meu carro não pega, o senhor tem cabos de bateria?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Han pintado el portal, ¡ha quedado muy bien!
small talk with a neighbour.en: They've painted the entrance hall; it looks great!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Pintaram a entrada do prédio, ficou muito bom!

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Qué tal su nuevo trabajo en el banco?
small talk with a neighbour.en: How's your new job at the bank going?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Como vai o seu novo trabalho no banco?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Cuidado, el suelo del portal está mojado.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Careful, the floor in the entrance hall is wet.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Cuidado, o chão da entrada está molhado.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Me voy a trabajar, ¡que tenga un buen día!
small talk with a neighbour.en: I'm off to work, have a nice day!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Estou indo trabalhar, tenha um bom dia!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Esta tarde hago un bizcocho, ¿quiere probarlo?
small talk with a neighbour.en: I'm baking a sponge cake this afternoon; would you like to try it?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Hoje à tarde vou fazer um bolo, quer provar?

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Ha recibido usted también la factura del agua?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you also received the water bill?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor também recebeu a conta de água?

phone calls and appointments.text: Hola, ¿puedo hablar con el señor García?
phone calls and appointments.en: Hello, may I speak to Mr García?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Alô, posso falar com o senhor García?

phone calls and appointments.text: Lo siento, se ha equivocado de número.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry, you've got the wrong number.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe, o senhor ligou para o número errado.

phone calls and appointments.text: Quería pedir cita para el martes por la mañana.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'd like to make an appointment for Tuesday morning.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu queria marcar um horário para terça de manhã.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿De parte de quién, por favor?
phone calls and appointments.en: Who's calling, please?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Quem fala, por favor?

phone calls and appointments.text: Un momento, ahora le paso con ella.
phone calls and appointments.en: One moment, I'll put you through to her now.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Um momento, já passo a ligação para ela.

phone calls and appointments.text: Te llamo más tarde, ahora estoy ocupado.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll call you later; I'm busy now.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Te ligo mais tarde, agora estou ocupado.

phone calls and appointments.text: Ayer te llamé tres veces, pero no contestaste.
phone calls and appointments.en: Yesterday I called you three times, but you didn't answer.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Ontem te liguei três vezes, mas você não atendeu.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Puede venir el jueves a las cinco y cuarto?
phone calls and appointments.en: Can you come on Thursday at quarter past five?
phone calls and appointments.pt: O senhor pode vir na quinta às cinco e quinze?

phone calls and appointments.text: Tengo cita con la dentista a las once.
phone calls and appointments.en: I have an appointment with the dentist at eleven.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Tenho consulta com a dentista às onze.

phone calls and appointments.text: Necesito cambiar la hora de mi cita.
phone calls and appointments.en: I need to change the time of my appointment.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Preciso mudar o horário da minha consulta.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Me puede dar su número de teléfono?
phone calls and appointments.en: Can you give me your phone number?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Pode me passar o seu número de telefone?

phone calls and appointments.text: Se ha cortado la llamada, te llamo otra vez.
phone calls and appointments.en: The call got cut off; I'll call you again.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A ligação caiu, vou te ligar de novo.

phone calls and appointments.text: Ahora mismo no está, ¿quiere dejar un mensaje?
phone calls and appointments.en: He isn't here right now; would you like to leave a message?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Ele não está no momento, quer deixar um recado?

phone calls and appointments.text: Mañana voy a llamar al banco para preguntar.
phone calls and appointments.en: Tomorrow I'm going to call the bank to ask.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Amanhã vou ligar para o banco para perguntar.

phone calls and appointments.text: Mi móvil no tiene batería, ¿me dejas el tuyo?
phone calls and appointments.en: My mobile is out of battery; can I borrow yours?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Meu celular está sem bateria, me empresta o seu?

phone calls and appointments.text: La consulta está abierta de nueve a dos.
phone calls and appointments.en: The surgery is open from nine to two.
phone calls and appointments.pt: O consultório fica aberto das nove às duas.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Puede repetir su nombre, por favor?
phone calls and appointments.en: Can you repeat your name, please?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Pode repetir o seu nome, por favor?

phone calls and appointments.text: He llamado a la peluquería para reservar hora.
phone calls and appointments.en: I've called the hairdresser's to book a slot.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Liguei para o cabeleireiro para marcar horário.

phone calls and appointments.text: Hable más alto, por favor, no le oigo bien.
phone calls and appointments.en: Speak up, please, I can't hear you well.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Fale mais alto, por favor, não estou ouvindo bem.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le llamo para confirmar su cita de mañana.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm calling to confirm your appointment tomorrow.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Estou ligando para confirmar a sua consulta de amanhã.

phone calls and appointments.text: Lo siento, tengo que cancelar la cita del viernes.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry, I have to cancel Friday's appointment.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe, preciso cancelar a consulta de sexta.

phone calls and appointments.text: Te mando un mensaje con la dirección exacta.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll send you a message with the exact address.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vou te mandar uma mensagem com o endereço exato.

phone calls and appointments.text: Hoy no hay citas libres hasta las seis.
phone calls and appointments.en: There are no free appointments today until six.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Hoje não tem horário livre até as seis.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Llamo yo a la tienda o llamas tú?
phone calls and appointments.en: Shall I call the shop or will you?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu ligo para a loja ou você liga?

phone calls and appointments.text: Ayer hablé con el técnico por teléfono.
phone calls and appointments.en: Yesterday I spoke to the technician on the phone.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Ontem falei com o técnico por telefone.

phone calls and appointments.text: Mi cita con el abogado es a las tres y media.
phone calls and appointments.en: My appointment with the lawyer is at half past three.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Meu horário com o advogado é às três e meia.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Tiene algún hueco libre esta semana?
phone calls and appointments.en: Do you have a free slot this week?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Tem algum horário livre esta semana?

phone calls and appointments.text: Disculpe, ¿con quién hablo, por favor?
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry, who am I speaking to, please?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe, com quem eu falo, por favor?

phone calls and appointments.text: Llámame esta noche después de las nueve.
phone calls and appointments.en: Call me tonight after nine.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Me liga hoje à noite depois das nove.

phone calls and appointments.text: He dejado un mensaje en tu contestador.
phone calls and appointments.en: I've left a message on your answering machine.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Deixei uma mensagem na sua secretária eletrônica.

phone calls and appointments.text: El número de la clínica está en la web.
phone calls and appointments.en: The clinic's number is on the website.
phone calls and appointments.pt: O número da clínica está no site.

phone calls and appointments.text: Mañana te llamo para quedar, ¿vale?
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll call you tomorrow to arrange to meet, OK?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Amanhã te ligo para a gente combinar, tá bom?

phone calls and appointments.text: Llegué cinco minutos tarde a mi cita con el médico.
phone calls and appointments.en: I was five minutes late for my doctor's appointment.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Cheguei cinco minutos atrasado à minha consulta médica.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿A qué hora es tu cita en la embajada?
phone calls and appointments.en: What time is your appointment at the embassy?
phone calls and appointments.pt: A que horas é o seu horário na embaixada?

phone calls and appointments.text: El teléfono de la oficina siempre está ocupado.
phone calls and appointments.en: The office phone is always engaged.
phone calls and appointments.pt: O telefone do escritório está sempre ocupado.

phone calls and appointments.text: Buenos días, llamo por el anuncio del piso.
phone calls and appointments.en: Good morning, I'm calling about the flat advert.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Bom dia, estou ligando por causa do anúncio do apartamento.

phone calls and appointments.text: Te veo el lunes a las diez en la puerta.
phone calls and appointments.en: See you on Monday at ten at the door.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A gente se vê na segunda às dez na porta.

phone calls and appointments.text: Perdona, no puedo hablar, estoy en el cine.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry, I can't talk, I'm at the cinema.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpa, não posso falar, estou no cinema.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Me puede llamar mañana por la mañana?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could you call me tomorrow morning?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Pode me ligar amanhã de manhã?

phone calls and appointments.text: Voy a apuntar la cita en mi agenda.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm going to write the appointment in my diary.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vou anotar o compromisso na minha agenda.
